<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition for the given product. The previous task returned a dictionary containing the template ID (and the mapped reaction). Since the exact dictionary isn’t shown, we will search the template catalog for a Diels‑Alder‑type transformation (formation of a new six‑membered ring, i.e., a 6‑6 bond) and then apply the found template to the target SMILES to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
